name: Venice of the East Open 2018
information: There is no on-spot registration. Participation limit is 50, so register as soon as possible. Registration closes either on June 8, 2018, 11:59 p.m. IST or when registration count reaches 50 (whichever comes first) [Click here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VeniceoftheEastOpen2018/register) to register.
